'''Volume 13''' is the thirteenth volume published by [[VIZ Media]] compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Sword & Shield}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of [[Shogakukan]]'s collected releases of the magazine version.

==Blurb==
''Our team meets the legendary Pokémon Calyrex, also known as the King of Bountiful Harvest! With the King's aid, Henry is finally reunited with the Rusted Sword and Rusted Shield.''

''Will finally collecting the lost items be the end of our heroes' journey?''
